title: Your data is protected. Our promises to every nursery.
lead: We look after the data side, so you can look after the children.
imageAlt: A computer screen showing a green security shield with a padlock, surrounded by charts and security icons in a bright office.

items.title: Encrypted
items.body: Your data is encrypted while it travels and while it is stored.

items.title: Backed up daily.
items.body: Automatic. Nothing to remember, nothing to configure.

items.title: Access by role
items.body: A teacher sees only their own rooms. An admin cannot read private teacher and parent conversations.

items.title: Kept only as long as needed
items.body: Incident reports for two years. Chat deleted automatically after six months.

items.title: Parents never pay
items.body: Parents use the app for free. The nursery pays.

items.title: Your data stays yours
items.body: Your records are yours. Export them whenever you want, without asking us.

items.title: One flat fee
items.body: One flat monthly fee, paid by the nursery. No commission on tuition.
